name: Compute Cluster S22: Cross-Sectional Ranking
description: Tests: rank() ordinal, rank_quantile() percentile, zscore(cross_sectional=True), agg with cross_sectional=True. Validates rank-based vs z-score-based selection.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S22: Cross-Sectional Ranking
# Tests: rank, rank_quantile, zscore(cross_sectional), cs agg
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close, 21)

# === ORDINAL RANK ===
# rank: 1 = lowest by default (ascending)
ret_rank = rank(ret)
ret_rank_desc = rank(ret, ascending=False)   # 1 = highest

# === PERCENTILE RANK ===
# rank_quantile: 0.0-1.0, distribution-free
ret_pctile = rank_quantile(ret)

# CORRECT: rank-based bottom 20% selection
is_bottom_20 = ret_pctile <= 0.20

# === CROSS-SECTIONAL Z-SCORE ===
ret_zscore = zscore(cross_sectional=True)(ret)

# === CROSS-SECTIONAL MEAN ===
ret_cs_mean = agg(ret, AggregationType.Mean, cross_sectional=True)
ret_vs_mean = ret - ret_cs_mean

# === REPORTERS ===
cs_lines(
    title='1M Return Rank (1=lowest)',
    category='CS Ranking'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ret_rank)

cs_lines(
    title='1M Return Percentile (0-1)',
    category='CS Ranking'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ret_pctile)

cs_lines(
    title='Cross-Sectional Z-Score',
    category='CS Ranking'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ret_zscore)

cards(
    category='CS Ranking',
    layout=CardLayout(title='Ranking Stats', cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Percentile', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Z-Score', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
    ])
)((ret_pctile, ret_zscore))
